overloads.semanticRole: The SET DEFAULT CENTURY command specifies the default century and the pivot year used by 4D when you enter a date with only two digits for the year.

constraints: century is the century value minus one (e.g. pass 20 to switch to the 21st century).
Default (if never called): century 20 (20th century) with pivotYear 30.
pivotYear rule: if the two-digit year is >= pivotYear, 4D uses the current default century; if it is < pivotYear, 4D uses the next century.
